notes: Material values are serialized values extracted from the shipped Unity player; use them as presets instead of inventing values.
Runtime card/mask textures are injected into material slots and therefore some serialized materials contain sample card textures. Replace them at runtime.
The shipped reference materials have _SCROLLMODE_TIME enabled, but compiled shaders also contain _SCROLLMODE_TILT; CardFXRendering switches mode at runtime.
Silver_HighGloss uses the dedicated CardVarnishSilver overlay.
